answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 146571 Country: india Title: I am an engineering student. Is it compulsory for me to keep Shariah beard? Question: I am an engineering student. Is it compulsory for me to keep Shariah beard? Answer ID: 146571 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 246/229/M=2/1438) Yes, according to sunnah it is wajib for each Muslim to grow the beard. The same ruling is for you as well. One shall get greater reward as per his sufferings if he follows the sunnah in opposite environment. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
